title: Launch CSV rerun audit link
summary: Added a Launch > CSV Rerun quick-link button that opens Reports with the Audit tab selected.
reason: Operators preparing a CSV rerun need a direct path back to the Reports audit tooling that owns audit rows, score policy, ignore controls, and backend-owned rerun CSV export.
